records.title: ICL-Router: In-Context Learned Model Representations for LLM Routing
records.reason: Routing may reduce calls to all candidate models, but this paper primarily optimizes routing quality/scalability; comparative total latency/cost evidence is limited.

records.title: Coevolutionary Continuous Discrete Diffusion: Make Your Diffusion Language Model a Latent Reasoner
records.reason: The paper studies expressivity and trainability of continuous/discrete diffusion language reasoners; its stated contribution is reasoning representation/capability, not inference efficiency.

records.title: Quagmires in SFT-RL Post-Training: When High SFT Scores Mislead and What to Use Instead
records.reason: The work analyzes SFT/RL post-training quality metrics and downstream RL outcomes; it does not reduce inference/serving cost.

records.title: dVLA: Diffusion Vision-Language-Action Model with Multimodal Chain-of-Thought
records.reason: The method is a diffusion vision-language-action robotics model with task-specific action inference; transfer to text LLM serving is weak.

records.title: CSC-SQL: Corrective Self-Consistency in Text-to-SQL via Reinforcement Learning
records.reason: CSC-SQL combines parallel self-consistency sampling with corrective revision to improve text-to-SQL accuracy, increasing test-time compute rather than optimizing it.
